entities.name: Query protein 176 aa
observations: Sequence length is 176 aa; estimated molecular mass is 19.35 kDa.
Predicted theoretical pI is 5.11 with approximately −9.8 net charge at pH 7; sequence is mildly hydrophilic and lacks an obvious membrane-spanning segment.
Pfam detects an ARD domain (PF03079.21) at residues 16–158 with i-Evalue 2.4e−21.
Best reviewed homologs are bacterial acireductone dioxygenases with 54.7–56.9% identity, 100% query coverage, and E-values 1.0e−62 to 1.9e−65.
Likely function is acireductone dioxygenase in methionine salvage; exact Fe-versus-Ni reaction preference cannot be established from sequence similarity alone.

entities.name: Q3KFI8
observations: Reviewed Pseudomonas fluorescens acireductone dioxygenase; annotated as Fe2+- and Ni2+-dependent, monomeric, and involved in methionine salvage.
Reference annotations report catalytic residues/features near positions 96–105 and 141, but those positions are not directly mapped to the query sequence by the tool.

entities.name: Q48KM7
observations: Reviewed Pseudomonas savastanoi acireductone dioxygenase homolog with 54.7% identity and full-length coverage to the query.

entities.name: Q4ZVB9
observations: Reviewed Pseudomonas syringae acireductone dioxygenase homolog with 55.2% identity and full-length coverage to the query.

entities.name: Methionine salvage pathway
observations: Acireductone dioxygenase is annotated in bacterial L-methionine salvage, where Fe-bound enzyme produces 2-keto-4-methylthiobutyrate and formate.

entities.name: ARD metal dependence
observations: Reviewed homologs bind one Fe2+ or one Ni2+ per monomer; metal identity can alter the acireductone dioxygenase reaction outcome.
For the query, metal binding and metal-specific product preference remain inferred rather than experimentally demonstrated.
